intro.text: The spren that make the Oathgates work. They carry anything on a gate's platform and in its control room to a matching gate in Urithiru or one other city.

description.text: They can be Enlightened, which does not stop them sending travellers to unEnlightened ones.
They look like enormous armoured statues holding spears, many times a person's height. They come in pairs, one shimmering white and one shimmering black, and act and speak together.
They once let people without the Surge of Transportation travel to and from Shadesmar, but the Sibling forbade it before withdrawing. They regret this but cannot disobey.
An Oathgate can be rebuilt as long as its spren are unharmed. They seem bound to the eleven gemstones used to work it.
Some gatekeepers have since agreed to the Stormfather's request to allow travel to Shadesmar again.
